postCutoffFundamentalChecks.source: 山鹰纸业2018年半年度报告
postCutoffFundamentalChecks.claim: H1 revenue RMB11.954bn +60.21%, attributable profit RMB1.706bn +106.48%, operating cash flow RMB2.422bn +995.48%; paper gross margin 26.06%, +1.13pp YoY.
postCutoffFundamentalChecks.diagnosticMeaning: The pre-cutoff quota/cost thesis was not invalidated by the first subsequent operating report; realized earnings and paper margins strengthened.

postCutoffFundamentalChecks.source: 山鹰纸业2018年半年度报告
postCutoffFundamentalChecks.claim: In the first 17 quota batches Shanying received 2.0389m tons, 14.52% of total quota, with a quota-to-paper-capacity ratio above larger peers.
postCutoffFundamentalChecks.diagnosticMeaning: The upstream access state identified before cutoff remained real and became more concentrated.

postCutoffRegimeChanges.source: 国务院关税税则委员会
postCutoffRegimeChanges.event: China announced a 25% additional tariff on the adjusted second list of roughly USD16bn of US-origin imports, effective 2018-08-23.
postCutoffRegimeChanges.thesisAttack: The frozen thesis depended on low-cost imported recycled fiber; additional tariffs on US-origin waste-paper flows directly compress that input-cost advantage.

postCutoffRegimeChanges.source: Official tariff implementation / contemporaneous paper-industry follow-up
postCutoffRegimeChanges.event: The 25% tariff took effect. Later 2018 paper-industry evidence showed US-waste-paper's pre-existing price advantage versus domestic waste paper was materially eroded/reversed by September-October.
postCutoffRegimeChanges.thesisAttack: A new cost regime can invalidate an otherwise-correct quota-access thesis without implying the original cutoff research was wrong.

causalDiagnosis.explanation: Cutoff-valid evidence correctly identified Shanying's quota/access advantage, low valuation and realized Q1 earnings. But the deep pack omitted equally cutoff-valid evidence of rapid debt-funded expansion, high short-term debt, rising leverage and goodwill/liquidity risk. That omission made pass/credible quality/downside labels too strong. Separately, a new August tariff shock later attacked the imported-fiber cost edge. The 20d underperformance already predates that tariff, so the entire miss cannot be attributed to post-cutoff policy.

skillImplication.monitoringRequirement: After selection, re-underwrite when new evidence directly changes the frozen causal state variable, cost bridge or falsifier.
skillImplication.replayRequirement: Keep entry-quality and post-entry re-underwrite evaluation separate: pre-cutoff omitted risks diagnose selection research; post-cutoff shocks diagnose monitoring.
skillImplication.antiOverfit: Do not create a paper-specific tariff exception. The generic rule is thesis-attacking state change -> immediate re-underwrite.
skillImplication.discoveryRequirement: For every prospective Primary company, require a dedicated adversarial company-risk search lane covering leverage/liquidity, refinancing, dilution, acquisitions/goodwill, governance and material contingent obligations before quality/downside can be pass/credible.

cutoffValidAdversarialEvidenceMissedByDe.source: 经济参考报/看点资讯转载
cutoffValidAdversarialEvidenceMissedByDe.claim: Public reporting highlighted rapid M&A/capex expansion and recurring concerns over high debt and liquidity risk before the cutoff.
cutoffValidAdversarialEvidenceMissedByDe.diagnosticMeaning: The Skill found the positive quota/cost chain but did not seek an equally strong company-risk lane before assigning a Primary quality floor.

cutoffValidAdversarialEvidenceMissedByDe.source: 经济参考报/中华纸业传媒
cutoffValidAdversarialEvidenceMissedByDe.claim: At 2018Q1, liabilities were RMB20.073bn; total debt RMB16.008bn, up 23.27% from year-end; short-term debt represented 74.25% of total debt; asset-liability ratio was 64.49%. Credit-rating commentary said debt burden had risen, short-term repayment pressure existed, and goodwill impairment risk was material.
cutoffValidAdversarialEvidenceMissedByDe.diagnosticMeaning: This is cutoff-valid evidence directly relevant to balanceSheetOrSurvival, qualityFloor and downsideContainment. It should have been in the deep pack.
